title: DepEd saves ₱1.4B in landmark procurement of laptops via open bidding

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Department of Education (DepEd) saved at least P1.4 billion in procuring more than 231,000 laptops for public school teachers through an open and competitive bidding instead of through a negotiated procurement, Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a statement on Friday. The procurement covers 169,008 Mac-based and 62,717 Windows-based laptops for teachers. The package includes 3,646 Mac-based units for administrative officers. Aside from significant cost reductions, Angara pushed for the inclusion of an unprecedented five-year extended warranty to ensure that technology used for long-term educational services remains fully operational over extended periods.
